selection: Four latest owned databases by catalog OID, immediately after guarded default/runtime pair; root was sole database executor
inspection: Read-only owner queries; exact fixture output comparison done in SQL, no body/token/hash values emitted
initial_inspection_error: First read-only query used runs.run_id, which does not exist; no inspection result was produced. Source confirms runs.id; corrected query follows. This was not a test failure.
query:
SELECT json_build_object(
'database',current_database(),
'run_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM runs),
'run_statuses',(SELECT array_agg(status ORDER BY id) FROM runs),
'exact_250k_succeeded_outputs',(SELECT count(*) FROM steps s JOIN payloads p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.digest=s.output_digest WHERE s.status='SUCCEEDED' AND octet_length(p.content)=250000 AND p.content=convert_to(chr(34)||repeat('x',249998)||chr(34),'UTF8')),
'session_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM worker_sessions),
'sha256_session_hash_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM worker_sessions WHERE octet_length(token_hash)=32),
'worker_receipt_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM command_dedupe WHERE scope LIKE 'step:%'),
'sha256_worker_receipt_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM command_dedupe WHERE scope LIKE 'step:%' AND octet_length(request_hash)=32),
'leftover_receipt_gates',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='api_reopen_public_receipt_gate'))
